title: Habits
learning_outcomes: Explain cues and routines in the context of habits.
Compare and distinguish environmental friction in the context of habits.
Apply implementation intentions in the context of habits.
Evaluate and justify decisions about iteration in the context of habits.

lessons.title: Cues and routines
lessons.outcome: Explain cues and routines in the context of habits.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving cues and routines; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to seven-day habit experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain cues and routines from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of cues and routines; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Environmental friction
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish environmental friction in the context of habits.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving environmental friction; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to seven-day habit experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain environmental friction from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of environmental friction; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Implementation intentions
lessons.outcome: Apply implementation intentions in the context of habits.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving implementation intentions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to seven-day habit experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain implementation intentions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of implementation intentions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Iteration
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about iteration in the context of habits.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving iteration; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to seven-day habit experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain iteration from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of iteration; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of cues and routines; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of environmental friction; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of implementation intentions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of iteration; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
